# Lianjia Fence

> Anping Lianjia Metal Products Co., Ltd. — factory-direct wire fencing manufacturer in Anping, Hebei, China (the world's "wire mesh capital"). We manufacture and export farm and perimeter fencing worldwide, FOB Tianjin.

## Company

- Name: Anping Lianjia Metal Products Co., Ltd.
- Location: Anping, Hebei, China
- Website: https://lianjiafence.com
- Contact: sales@lianjiafence.com | +86 136 0318 1774
- Trade terms: FOB Tianjin, worldwide shipping; LCL / shared container accepted

## Products (factory-direct)

- [Field Fence — Hinge Joint & Ring Lock](https://lianjiafence.com/products/field-fence.html) — high-tensile, hot-dip galvanized; size codes 6/90/30 to 13/115/15; heights 80–180 cm; zinc 40–230 g/m²
- [Chain Link Fence (Diamond Mesh)](https://lianjiafence.com/products/chain-link-fence.html) — galvanized / PVC-coated diamond mesh
- [Y Post / Star Picket](https://lianjiafence.com/products/y-post.html) — Q235 steel, plain / scalloped / studded profiles, 1.5–2.4 m lengths
- [Galvanized Posts & Rails](https://lianjiafence.com/products/galvanized-posts-rails.html) — Gal Cattle rail 115×42×2×6100 mm (~27.5 kg) & Gal Posts 75×75×3×2400 mm (~16.4 kg), 390 g/m² hot-dip galvanized
- Barbed Wire / Plain Wire — High Tensile & IOWA barbed wire, binding wire, high-tensile line wire (see [homepage products](https://lianjiafence.com/#products))

## Standards & Coatings

- AS/NZS 4534 — zinc/alu-zinc coatings on steel wire (star pickets, line wire)
- AS/NZS 4680 — hot-dip galvanized (zinc) coatings on fabricated steel
- ASTM A641 / A510, ISO 1461 available on request
- Zinc coating options: 40 / 80 / 120 / 200 / 230 / 390 g/m²
